body:
Generalized MODE_TYLER's third-person camera from a demo-shaped hack (MODE_TYLER && forced_kit==AI_KIT_LEELA) into a real, standalone, wire-synced PlayerState.third_person/NetPlayer.third_person field, following forced_kit's own established pattern. Camera branch in apps/lobby/src/main.c now keys on render_p->third_person alone -- mode-agnostic, skin-agnostic -- so MODE_STORY's future night register can request third person with one field. make server/lobby both clean, zero new warnings; re-ran the live end-to-end MODE_TYLER smoke test on a non-conflicting port, identical log sequence, zero drift. SHANKPIT commit pending.
